I’m Samir Chaulagain.

I’m a Senior Civil Engineer based in Hamilton, New Zealand. My work brings together land development, three-waters design, construction support and a steady interest in making the process better.

I started in practical roles: construction, surveying, set-out and site data. Working with levels and real site constraints taught me that a design is only as useful as its path to delivery.

That perspective has stayed with me as I’ve moved into technical leadership, mentoring, quality systems and digital engineering.

Outside project work, I help people connect through cultural programmes, professional events and community initiatives. The setting changes. The purpose stays close: make things work better for people.

Surveying & construction

Construction experience with Foster Construction, followed by survey assistance at CKL: topographical and land-transfer surveys, set-out, levels and practical field information.

Completed civil engineering diploma study while working as Front of House Manager at Viet Thai Village, building early experience in customer service, team coordination and responsibility.
